The fraction of cobalt(II) dithiocyanato complexes (Co(SCN)₂) is determined by the stability constants and the free thiocyanate concentration. Given [SCN⁻] = 0.1 M and the overall stability constants β₁ = 9, β₂ = 40, β₃ = 63, β₄ = 16, the fraction α₂ is:

α₂ = (β₂[L]²) / (1 + β₁[L] + β₂[L]² + β₃[L]³ + β₄[L]⁴)

Calculate each term:
β₁[L] = 9 × 0.1 = 0.9
β₂[L]² = 40 × 0.01 = 0.4
β₃[L]³ = 63 × 0.001 = 0.063
β₄[L]⁴ = 16 × 0.0001 = 0.0016

Denominator = 1 + 0.9 + 0.4 + 0.063 + 0.0016 = 2.3646
α₂ = 0.4 / 2.3646 ≈ 0.1692 = 16.9%

Answer: D
